heading: INT. STALLED CABLE CAR GONDOLA - DAY

units.text: INT. STALLED CABLE CAR GONDOLA - DAY
RAVI, forties, a hiking guide, sits on the floor with his boots braced against the door.
NKECHI, thirties, grips the rail.
OLEG, seventies, holds a thermos in both hands.
PILAR, twenties, films the white nothing outside on her phone.
The gondola has been still for two hours.
He licks his lips.
She lowers the phone.
They all look at the roof as it ticks in the cold.
Rescue said four hours. That was one hour ago, so three.
units.name: RAVI

units.text: It was two hours ago. So two.
units.name: NKECHI

units.text: It is whatever number keeps us calm. I choose three.
units.name: OLEG

units.text: My battery is nineteen percent.
units.name: PILAR

units.text: Then stop filming the clouds.
units.name: RAVI

units.text: They're getting closer.
units.name: PILAR

units.text: Clouds don't get closer. We get lower.
units.name: NKECHI

units.text: Nobody said lower.
units.name: OLEG

units.text: The cable sags in the cold. It is normal. Everybody breathe slowly, in through the nose.
units.name: RAVI

units.text: I am breathing. I'm breathing so loudly.
units.name: PILAR

units.text: We are fine. Somebody pour the tea.
units.name: NKECHI

units.text: Last cup is mine. After that, we take turns.
units.name: OLEG
